Overview

Kranj is a city in Kranj with a population of 37,373. The capital of the Gorenjska region, the birthplace of poet France Prešeren, with a historic old town and proximity to the stunning Lake Bled and Triglav National Park. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
